scope: Static ownership/overlap audit for the two remaining prepared page264 visual microfixes. No WordPress write.

live_tool_state.wpvibe: Disabled on the first preflight call; no retry and no WordPress write.
live_tool_state.opera: One existing tab was reused for target and exactly one reference tab was opened, reaching the two-tab maximum. The first screenshot call disconnected the connector; no replacement tabs or repeated reconnect loop were used.

accepted_live_layers.v004: Live page264 comparison/form source mapping. Preserve exactly.
accepted_live_layers.v005: Live narrow comparison cascade correction. Preserve exactly.
accepted_live_layers.conclusion: v005 does not set display, grid-template-columns, gap, child width/min-width/max-width or any request-contact text color. Therefore v006 and v007 do not overwrite a v005-owned accepted property.

v006_contact_foreground.overlap_with_v004: Intentional value-identical strengthening only. v004 already declares source white contact button/strong text and rgba(255,255,255,.9) label text, but fresh live evidence showed those colors losing the cascade.
v006_contact_foreground.overlap_with_v003: v003 owns hover/focus transform and box-shadow plus width breakpoints. v006 changes neither; its base contact foreground makes the source-white color win without changing geometry.
v006_contact_foreground.responsive_risk: None identified: no width, padding, font-size, display, position or breakpoint declaration in v006.
v006_contact_foreground.icon_effect: Existing contact icon SVG uses currentColor, so forcing the button foreground to source white also keeps the icon source-white without a second icon rule.
v006_contact_foreground.specificity_note: Selectors include page-id-264, #ajanlatkeres and af2a0054 ownership; the !important is confined to the proven losing color declarations.

v007_comparison_grid.overlap_with_v004: Intentional value-identical strengthening of the source grid contract: display:grid, repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)), 24px gap, stretch. The exact standalone artifact resets only width/max-width/min-width on the cards; it does not set flex or box-sizing.
v007_comparison_grid.overlap_with_v005: No conflicting property. v005 owns card stretch/height and surfaces only. v007 preserves those declarations and does not set background, border, height, align-self, icon, bullet, typography or copy properties.
v007_comparison_grid.responsive_contract: At max-width:900px v007 keeps exactly one minmax(0,1fr) column, consistent with v004/source. It does not change the v004 max-width:720px card padding rule.
v007_comparison_grid.specificity_note: The !important is limited to the source grid contract and three card width constraints already associated with the live unequal-column cascade. It is not a broad card restyle.

combined_bundle.allowed_only_when: A fresh same-state source/target gate proves both v006 and v007 failures simultaneously and both new marker counts are zero.
combined_bundle.benefit: One Additional CSS match-once insertion and one closeout instead of two writes, reducing call/cascade risk.
combined_bundle.forbidden_when: If only one failure reproduces, deploy only its standalone block. If neither reproduces, write nothing.

v004/v003 request panel geometry, organic glow and hover lift
